alert.backup_stale: Last successful backup was {hours} hours ago.
alert.brain_down: The brain does not answer its health check.
alert.brain_manifest_invalid: The brain manifest on this server is invalid.
alert.firewall_off: The firewall is off: the server may be reachable from the internet.
alert.reboot_required: Updates are waiting for a reboot (for {days} days). Reboot when convenient: sudo pskit prove
alert.restore_failed: The restore test failed: restored files did not match.
alert.restore_stale: The restore test has not run for {days} days.
alert.tailscale: The private network is down (Tailscale: {state}). This is the only way in.
alerts.none_warning: Without alerts, a full disk or a failed backup goes unnoticed until it hurts.
alerts.ntfy_1: Install the ntfy app on your phone (App Store or Google Play).
alerts.ntfy_2: In the app, subscribe to this topic on {server}:
alerts.ntfy_3: The topic name is random and works like a password: do not share it.
alerts.opt_telegram: Telegram (a private bot only you talk to)
alerts.test_arrived: Did the test alert arrive on your phone?
alerts.test_body: If you can read this, alerts from your server reach you.
alerts.test_failed: The test alert could not be sent ({error}).
alerts.tg_1: In Telegram, open a chat with @BotFather and send /newbot.
alerts.tg_2: Pick any name and a user name ending in 'bot'.
alerts.tg_3: BotFather replies with a token (numbers, a colon, letters). Paste it below.
alerts.tg_bad_token: That token does not work. Copy it again from BotFather.
alerts.tg_no_chat: Your message to the bot did not arrive.
alerts.tg_no_chat_hint: Open the bot, press Start or send any message, then run the installer again.
alerts.tg_start: Now open your bot (link below) and press Start. Waiting for it...
backup.choose: Where should the encrypted backup go?
backup.failed_body: Last night's backup did not finish. It will be retried in the evening. If this repeats, run: sudo pskit doctor
backup.first_run: Running the first backup and a restore test...
backup.later_warning: No backup yet. The daily summary will remind you until one is configured.
backup.local_bad: Use an absolute path, for example /mnt/backup/pskit
backup.local_warning: A disk on the same machine protects against mistakes, not against losing the machine.
backup.not_proven: The backup has not been proven yet.
backup.opt_local: A disk attached to this machine (not a real backup if the machine is lost)
backup.opt_s3: Cloud storage (S3 compatible: Backblaze B2, Wasabi, AWS, Hetzner...)
backup.partial: Backup finished, but some files could not be read.
backup.proven: Backup works: {n} files restored and compared.
backup.pw_1: Your backup password (the only way to read the backup):
backup.pw_2: Save it now in your password manager.
backup.pw_3: Without it, nobody can restore your data, including you.
backup.pw_check: To confirm, type its first 6 characters
backup.pw_mismatch: Those are not the first 6 characters. Look again.
backup.pw_not_saved: The backup password was not confirmed.
backup.repo_failed: Could not open or create the backup repository: {error}
backup.repo_hint: Check the destination and the access keys, then run the installer again.
backup.restic_checksum: The downloaded backup tool did not match its published checksum. Nothing was installed.
backup.restic_unsupported: The backup tool is not available for {target}.
backup.s3_help: You need a bucket and an access key limited to it. The repository looks like s3:https://<endpoint>/<bucket>/<folder>
backup.sftp_key_1: On the destination machine, add the whole line shown below this box to that user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys.
backup.sftp_key_2: The private key stays on this server, readable by root only. The start of the line limits it, on the destination, to the file transfer the backup uses: no terminal, commands or tunnels.
backup.tailnet_policy: Tailscale reaches {address}, but your tailnet's access rules block SSH to it. In the Tailscale admin console, under Access controls, let this server ({me}) reach {address}, then run the installer again.
brain.not_healthy: The brain did not answer its health check after starting.
brain.reserved: Reserved for the brain: {path}. Install it later with: sudo pskit brain apply <manifest>
budget.not_applied: The memory limit was not applied (reported: {got}).
budget.summary: Memory: brain up to {brain}, your sessions up to {user}, {margin} kept for the system.
ci.attach_hint: Attach a runner service with: sudo pskit ci attach <runner>.service
ci.attached: {unit} now runs inside the CI memory limit.
cli.device_forgotten: '{device}' removed: {keys} key(s) revoked. Its delivered sessions stay in the inbox.
cli.need_root: This command needs administrator rights: run it with sudo.
cli.not_installed: The kit is not installed on this machine.
cli.notify_denied: Not allowed: your account is not in the 'pskit' group (log out and back in after the install).
device.address: Server address (shown on the server's screen)
device.bridge_failed: Session delivery failed: {error}. It retries every 15 minutes.
device.code: Pairing code (shown on the server's screen)
device.code_bad: The code has 8 characters, like ABCD-2345.
device.confirm_failed: Could not log in to the server through the private network ({detail}).
device.confirmed: Access through the private network confirmed.
device.confirming: Confirming access through the private network...
device.name: Name for this computer
device.name_bad: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
device.passphrase: ssh-keygen now asks for a passphrase for your personal key to this server. It is optional: press Enter twice for none. With one, the key stays protected if someone copies this computer's files.
device.tailnet_policy: Tailscale reaches the server {address}, but your tailnet's access rules block the connection. In the Tailscale admin console, under Access controls, let this computer ({me}) and the server ({address}) reach each other, then run the installer again.
device.too_many: Too many attempts. Start the pairing again on the server.
device.ts_1: This computer needs Tailscale, signed in to the same account as the server.
device.ts_2: Install it, sign in, and leave this window open: it continues by itself.
device.ts_install_ask: Tailscale is not installed on this computer. Install it now (from Tailscale's signed repository, needs your password)?
device.ts_login_2: Sign in with the same account as the server. This computer then joins your private network.
device.ts_setup_failed: Could not set up Tailscale here ({error}). Install it from https://tailscale.com/download, sign in, and run the installer again.
device.ts_timeout: Tailscale did not start on this computer.
device.tunnel_not_yet: The brain tunnel is not up yet. It retries by itself; check with: pskit doctor
device.unreachable: Cannot reach the server at {address}:{port}. Check that Tailscale is on here and that the server is showing the pairing code.
digest.device: Sessions from '{device}': last delivery {hours} h ago ({files} files).
digest.reboot_pending: Updates are waiting for a reboot.
digest.title: daily summary {date}
doctor.audit_caps: Memory ceilings sum to {total} of {ram} ({margin} left for the system).
doctor.audit_cgroup2: cgroups v2 available (needed for memory limits).
doctor.audit_linux_only: The audit covers Linux servers for now.
doctor.audit_no_caps: No memory ceiling is set: one runaway process can take the whole machine.
doctor.audit_reboot_yes: Updates are waiting for a reboot.
doctor.dev_ssh_include: SSH configuration includes the kit's server entries.
doctor.lockdown_pending: A change of access rules waits for confirmation ({seconds} s before automatic undo).
doctor.needs_root: Could not check {what} without administrator rights (run with sudo).
doctor.nothing: Nothing installed here yet. Run the installer, or use: pskit doctor --audit
doctor.notify_retry: {n} alert(s) could not be delivered and wait for retry.
doctor.proof_never: The reboot proof has not run yet.
doctor.server_needs_root: This machine is a server: run `sudo pskit doctor` for its checks.
doctor.ts_expiry: Tailscale key expires in {days} days: disable key expiry for this machine in the admin console.
doctor.ts_no_expiry: Tailscale key expiry is off for this machine.
engine.not_in_state: The change did not take effect.
heartbeat.1: A server cannot tell you it is dead. An outside watcher can: your server pings it every 5 minutes, and it alerts you when the pings stop.
heartbeat.2: Free option: create a check at healthchecks.io (period 5 minutes, grace 10 minutes) and connect it to your phone or email.
heartbeat.3: Then paste the check's ping URL here.
heartbeat.ask: Set up the outside watcher now?
heartbeat.bad_url: The URL must start with https://
install.advanced: Show optional modules (CI runners, file share)?
install.blocked: Nothing was changed. Fix the item above and run the installer again.
install.config_unreadable: The existing configuration file could not be read. Continuing as a new install.
install.diag_hint: If you need help, send this file (it contains no passwords or keys):
install.existing: This machine is already set up as '{name}'. Installer version {version}.
install.existing_ask: What do you want to do?
install.existing_resume: Check everything and finish what is missing (safe to repeat)
install.interrupted: Stopped. Run the installer again to continue from where it stopped.
install.machine_name: Name for this server (lowercase, used in alerts and paths)
install.machine_name_bad: Use 3 to 32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
install.module_ci: Add a place and a memory limit for self-hosted CI runners?
install.module_samba: Share the workspace as a network folder (Finder, Explorer) over the private network?
install.need_sudo: Setting up a server needs administrator rights. You may be asked for your password.
install.owner: Your user name on this server (the account you will log in with)
install.owner_bad: Not a valid user name (and it cannot be root).
install.plan_1: Server '{name}' reachable only through your private network (Tailscale).
install.plan_2: Log in as '{owner}' with a key from your laptop; passwords turned off for SSH.
install.plan_3: A reserved place for your brain at {brain}, with its own memory limit.
install.plan_4: Alerts on your phone, a daily summary, encrypted backup with a tested restore.
install.plan_5: At the end, a reboot to prove everything comes back on its own.
install.relogin: Log out and back in once, so your account picks up its new groups.
install.resume_hint: Run the installer again to continue from where it stopped.
install.timezone: Time zone (for schedules and the daily summary)
install.tz_bad: Unknown time zone. Example: Europe/Berlin or America/Sao_Paulo.
local.1: Local only: the brain runs on this computer, and only while it is awake.
local.2: No server is configured. You can add one later by running this installer on it.
local.3: Set up the brain with the second brain kit:
lockdown.apply_failed: Could not close public access: {error}. Nothing was changed.
lockdown.box_1: Closing public access: SSH only through the private network, keys only.
lockdown.box_2: Your laptop confirms it can still get in. It does this by itself at the end of its pairing.
lockdown.box_3: If no confirmation arrives within {minutes} minutes, everything goes back to how it was.
lockdown.box_manual: If it does not confirm on its own (on a second attempt, for example), run this on the laptop:
lockdown.dropped_rules: These rules open SSH to the internet and will be replaced by the private network rule:
lockdown.existing_rules: This machine already has these firewall rules:
lockdown.hint: Check Tailscale on the laptop, then run the installer again here.
lockdown.keep_rules: Keep them? (SSH from the internet is closed either way)
lockdown.left: {minutes} min left before the automatic undo.
lockdown.not_confirmed: The laptop did not confirm, so public access was restored ({state}).
lockdown.reverted_body: Nobody confirmed the new access rules in time, so the previous ones were restored. Nothing else changed.
lockdown.waiting: Waiting for the laptop to confirm...
owner.must_exist_unattended: The user '{owner}' must exist before an unattended install.
owner.set_password: Choose a password for '{owner}'. It is used for administrator commands (sudo), never for logging in over the network.
pairing.box_1: Now connect your laptop to this server.
pairing.box_2: On your laptop, open a terminal and run:
pairing.box_3: Choose 'connect it to a server' and enter:
pairing.box_4: The laptop needs Tailscale too, signed in to the same account.
pairing.hint: Run the installer again when your laptop is ready.
pairing.no_tailnet: This server has no private network address yet.
pairing.retry: Try again with a new code?
pairing.waiting: Waiting for the laptop ({minutes} min left). Address {address}, code {code}.
preflight.container: This looks like a container ({kind}). Use a virtual machine or a real machine.
preflight.disk_low: Not enough free disk: {gib} GiB. At least 10 GiB is needed.
preflight.disk_tight: Free disk is tight: {gib} GiB. Agent histories and backups grow over time.
preflight.no_cgroup2: This machine does not use cgroups v2, which the memory limits need.
preflight.no_network: No internet connection to {host}. Check the network and try again.
preflight.no_systemd: This machine does not run systemd.
preflight.no_tmux: You are connected over SSH without tmux or screen. If the connection drops, just run the installer again: it continues where it stopped.
preflight.os_unsupported: Only Ubuntu 24.04 LTS is supported for now (found: {os}).
preflight.ram_low: Not enough memory: {gib} GiB. At least 4 GiB is needed.
preflight.ram_tight: Memory is tight: {gib} GiB. It works for sessions and a small brain, not for heavy builds.
pressure.frozen_body: Brain and CI jobs were paused (not stopped) to keep the server responsive. They resume by themselves when it recovers.
pressure.long_body: Paused brain and CI jobs were resumed anyway: something else keeps the server overloaded. Run: sudo pskit doctor
pressure.thawed: paused background jobs resumed after the pressure passed
proof.fail_body: {passed} of {total} checks passed. Not back: {failed}. Run: sudo pskit doctor
proof.fail_title: something did not come back after the reboot
proof.later_hint: Run it when convenient: sudo pskit prove
proof.not_done: The reboot proof has not run yet.
proof.ok_body: {passed} of {total} checks passed. The installation is complete.
proof.precheck_failed: These checks fail before the reboot: {failed}
proof.reboot_1: Last step: the server reboots to prove everything comes back on its own.
proof.reboot_2: You will lose this connection. In about 3 minutes the result arrives as an alert.
proof.reboot_3: You can also check from your laptop: ssh {name} pskit prove --status
proof.skipped: Reboot proof skipped. Run it later with: sudo pskit prove
reaper.browser: cleanup: a headless browser forgotten for {hours} h was closed
reaper.devserver: cleanup: a dev server idle for {hours} h was stopped
role.device: My laptop: connect it to a server I already set up
role.device_linux: My computer: connect it to a server I already set up
role.local: Only this computer, no server (the brain runs here while it is awake)
samba.invalid: The file share configuration is invalid.
samba.password: Choose a password for the network folder of '{owner}'.
samba.password_failed: The network folder password was not set.
step.storage: Folders for your work and your brain
swap.no_space: Not enough free disk for swap. Continuing without it.
swap.unsupported_fs: No swap created: swap files on {fs} need special handling.
tailscale.expiry_1: Important, once: turn off key expiry for this server in the Tailscale admin console.
tailscale.expiry_2: Open the page below, find '{name}', click the three dots and choose 'Disable key expiry'. Otherwise the server leaves your private network after 180 days.
tailscale.expiry_later: Remember to do it. The doctor command will keep reminding you.
tailscale.login_1: A login link will appear below. Open it in a browser and sign in to your Tailscale account.
tailscale.login_2: This server then joins your private network. No port is opened to the internet.
tailscale.login_3: The installer waits up to {minutes} minutes for the login. After that, run it again for a new link.
tailscale.login_failed: Tailscale did not finish logging in.
tailscale.login_hint: Run the installer again to get a new link.
ui.invalid_choice: That is not one of the options. Try again.

uninstall.backup_pw_2: Without it, the existing backups cannot be read.
uninstall.device_removed: This computer is no longer connected to '{server}'.

uninstall.lockdown_kept: Firewall and key-only SSH were kept (remove them with --remove-lockdown).
uninstall.lockdown_restored: Previous firewall and SSH settings restored.
uninstall.not_installed: The kit is not installed on this machine.
uninstall.pending_reverted: An access change that was never confirmed was undone first.
uninstall.records: The kit's records (journal, receipts, change ledger) were kept in {path}.

uninstall.type_name: Type the server name ({name}) to confirm
